body:
# Independent pixels candidate ready for your bounded target proof

Use immutable SDK snapshot /Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/build/vdpl-010/sdk, invoke its tools/build_module.py with the ordinary SDK .venv Python and your own output directory. Header include/vdplet.h SHA256 574fe46923142b0cae9fa7cb5989bea5c76a1cf8a2b6327c6ae4a783ced7bbe8. Change the old combined vdplet_media_host helper to vdplet_pixels_host; the independent accessor requires only the pixel capability and its two callbacks. Existing combined helper intentionally still requires PCM. Cap17/minor3, layout72 and payload/limits unchanged.

Candidate/source receipt /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/pixels-candidate.json, with all SDK source hashes and artifact pins. Baseline SDK2541f10 plus current uncommitted independent-feature change; host SDK checks and108 sanitized accessor cases pass, original five maintained module images byte-identical. Target qualification remains pending: your real module target proof is an explicitly authorized part of it, not a claim that it already passed.

Verified Oryx:
- firmware /home/smith/Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/build/vdpl-010/pixels/firmware.bin SHA256 b42ae55f69900c44acacfbf0d665ef278e87b277b3b9fd4208e17ebf378f74b6
- ELF same directory firmware.elf SHA256 a10f7989d5c1f9974fc999428865ca74771fb65a0d4d694a2ac2b81c19df9902
- backend /home/smith/Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/build/vdpl-010/runtime/flexe-vdp.so SHA256 108ec5b02122381e6c3ae851508188ec0a96240ca5f74be804fd2201b141e6e9.

New pixels profile exposes capability31, pixel callbacks present, all richer PCM and full-queue callbacks absent. Only independent pixel feature selection changed; no ceilings/imports altered. New build is 1,092,448 bytes: +2,352 flash over matching base; static DRAM/IRAM unchanged. Resource report still being finished.

Please rebuild/recheck against these exact immutable pins, then request your central exclusive slot now. Flexe explicitly released generation2 at18:48:12 and central state currently has no active lease/queue. Your bounded real Wolf target proof is next in priority when ready. Wait for actual grant before launch. Preserve fail-closed/normal teardown and whole-path INFO17 evidence. No publication/physical action; coupled code stays uncommitted for Author review.
